youtube.baslik: Can a model that works well at one center fail at another? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Machine learning models learn from labeled examples and work well for patients who resemble their training data. A model that memorizes its training data, or overfits, performs worse than expected on new patients; if an age or language group is missing, it may err there; and a model trained with one center's equipment and protocol may perform worse at another center. So external validation is the truly important step; clinical decision support only offers suggestions, and the responsibility belongs to the audiologist.
